search.query: | inputlookup risk_register.csv | stats dc(control_id) as controls_detected | append [ | inputlookup control_map.csv | stats dc(control_id) as controls_total ] | stats first(controls_detected) as controls_detected first(controls_total) as controls_total | eval control_coverage_pct = round((controls_detected/controls_total)*100,2) | table control_coverage_pct

| inputlookup risk_register.csv | eval event_ts=strptime(event_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), detect_ts=strptime(detected_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | where isnotnull(event_ts) AND isnotnull(detect_ts) | eval detect_delay_sec = detect_ts - event_ts | stats avg(detect_delay_sec) as avg_sec | eval MTTD_minutes = round(avg_sec/60,2) | table MTTD_minutes
| inputlookup risk_register.csv | search status="Open" | stats count by control_id control_name | sort -count
| inputlookup risk_register.csv | eval _time=strptime(detected_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | timechart span=1h count by residual_risk

chart.title: Open vs Closed Risks Over Time

search.query: | inputlookup risk_register.csv | eval _time=strptime(detected_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | timechart span=1h count by status
